title.english: A Way Back for the Hands

pairs.target: lín kē dào liànxí jiān shí , tǎ wéi zhèng jiāng liǎngzhī kōng mù tuō bǎi dào ǎi jiàshàng , zuǒyòu kàn le yíbiàn , yòu bǎ qízhōng yìzhī nuókāi bàn zhǎng .
pairs.english: When Lin Ke reached the practice room, Tavi was setting the two empty wooden carriers on a low rack; he checked left and right once, then moved one of them half a palm farther apart.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂到练习间时，塔维正将两只空木托摆到矮架上，左右看了一遍，又把其中一只挪开半掌。

pairs.target: tā zuórì wǔhòu wèn guò tā , tā zhǐ dāying láikàn tóu yíkè , jīnrì jìnmén biàn jiāng hùjù gē zài ménpáng , shuō zìjǐ děnghuìer háiyǒu kè , bú tì tā chāo cèzi .
pairs.english: He had asked her yesterday afternoon; she had agreed only to watch the first quarter-hour; coming in today, she put her gear beside the door, saying she had another class soon and would not copy his notebook for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他昨日午后问过她，她只答应来看头一刻，今日进门便将护具搁在门旁，说自己等会儿还有课，不替他抄册子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán méi xiǎng jiào tā chāo , tīngjiàn zhè jù dào dītóu kàn le yìyǎn zìjǐ de zì , sòng yuǎn zài hòutou xiào , jiào liǎng rén xiān biétì méi shuō chūlái dehuà chǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi had not meant to ask her to copy anything, but hearing that made him look down once at his handwriting; Song Yuan laughed behind them, telling both first not to argue over unspoken words.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原没想叫她抄，听见这句倒低头看了一眼自己的字，宋远在后头笑，叫两人先别替没说出来的话吵。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ ǎi jià yí dào bù diàn zhōngyāng , duǎnshéng liú zhe sōng liàng , mù tuō gē shàngqù shí bú huàng , jīnrì xiān méiyǒu tiě , yě bù jiē sòng yuǎn de zhǎng yā .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey moved the low rack to the middle of the cloth padding, leaving slack in the short cords; the carriers sat steady on it; today there was no iron at first, nor any palm pressure from Song Yuan.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把矮架移到布垫中央，短绳留着松量，木托搁上去时不晃，今日先没有铁，也不接宋远的掌压。

pairs.target: tā ràng tǎ wéi liǎng zhǎng tiē zài yuánlái de wèizhì , zài yìtóng tái kāi , huàn dào mù biān wòzhù , zuìhòu fàngkāi mù biān , liǎng zhǎng dōu huí yuánchù , jiàzi yìzhí tuō zhe dōngxī .
pairs.english: She had Tavi place both palms at the original spots, then lift them together, change to gripping the wooden edges, finally release those edges and return both palms; the rack supported the objects throughout.
pairs.hanzi: 她让塔维两掌贴在原来的位置，再一同抬开，换到木边握住，最后放开木边，两掌都回原处，架子一直托着东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhào zuò , yòushǒu huílái de kuài , zuǒshǒu què pèngdào zìjǐ juǎnqǐ de xiù biān , tā méi shǐjìndǐng guòqù , xiān jiāng mù tuō fàngwěn , zài bǎ nà yì jié chóngxīn shōujǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi complied; his right hand returned so quickly, but the left caught his rolled cuff; he did not force past it, first settling the carrier securely, then tightening that section again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照做，右手回来得快，左手却碰到自己卷起的袖边，他没使劲顶过去，先将木托放稳，再把那一截重新收紧。

pairs.target: lín kē shēn zhǐdiǎn le diǎn tā de zuǒ zhǒu , shuō cóngqián zìjǐ guòbúqù , jīnrì dào lún dào tā zìjǐ de shǒu huíbùlái le , tǎ wéi jiào tā bié zhǐ jì zhè yìhuí .
pairs.english: Lin Ke pointed a finger at his left elbow, saying before she could not get past, but today it was the turn of his own hand to fail to return; and Tavi told her not to remember only this attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂伸指点了点他的左肘，说从前自己过不去，今日倒轮到他自己的手回不来了，塔维叫她别只记这一回。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ gěi wǒ kàn lìngyìhuí . "
pairs.english: “Then you show me another attempt.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你给我看另一回。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán jiù jiāng shǒu shōuhuí , bú tì tā fú , tǎ wéi yǒuxiē nǎo , qǐ shǒu bǐ fāngcái kuài , zhǎng hái méiluò wěn , wéi lǎoshī biàn jiào tā tíng .
pairs.english: After speaking she drew her hand back, not supporting anything for him; Tavi grew annoyed and started faster than before; before his palm settled, Teacher Vey told him to stop.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完就将手收回，不替他扶，塔维有些恼，起手比方才快，掌还没落稳，维老师便叫他停。

pairs.target: liǎngzhī mù tuō méiyǒu diào , tā què zhīdào zìjǐ xiān gù yòubiān , zuǒbiān zhǐ děng zhe gēnshàng , sòng yuǎn wèn ruò mù biān kǎzhù ne , tā méi dá , xiān bǎshǒu fàng huí xī páng .
pairs.english: The two carriers had not fallen, but he knew he had attended to the right first, leaving the left only to follow; Song Yuan asked what if the wooden edge jammed then; he did not answer, first putting his hands back beside his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 两只木托没有掉，他却知道自己先顾右边，左边只等着跟上，宋远问若木边卡住呢，他没答，先把手放回膝旁。

pairs.target: gāo dèng jiù zài shēnhòu , zuǒ xī búbì shēn wān , tā zuòxià shí réng jìde yīzhě jiào zìjǐ biéjí zhe pǎotiào , méi náshǒu shàng de shì qù cuī jiǎo .
pairs.english: The high stool was right behind him, without a deep bend needed in his left knee; on sitting he still remembered the healer telling him not to rush into running or jumping, and did not let his hands' business hurry his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 高凳就在身后，左膝不必深弯，他坐下时仍记得医者叫自己别急着跑跳，没拿手上的事去催脚。

pairs.target: lín kē dūn dào jià biān kàn , wèn shìbushì dōu zhào yígè dìfāng huílái , wéi lǎoshī shuō jīnrì shì , liǎngchù fàngzài nǎlǐ yě méi jiào tā línshí cāi , lín kē biàn jiào tā xiān kànkàn zuǒshǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Ke crouched beside the rack to look, asking whether they always returned to the same spots; Teacher Vey said yes for today, and he had not been asked to guess where either place should be set on the fly; Lin Ke then told him to look at the left hand first.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂蹲到架边看，问是不是都照一个地方回来，维老师说今日是，两处放在哪里也没叫他临时猜，林珂便叫他先看看左手。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng guòqù , cái fāxiànzìjǐ yì shuō liǎngzhīshǒu , yǎnjīng zǒng xiān qù yòubiān , zuǒ zhǒu què méiyǒu yìtóng liúchū néng huílái de nà diǎn kòng chù .
pairs.english: Only when Tavi looked over did he realise that saying both hands always sent his eyes right first, while his left elbow failed to leave the little space for returning at the same time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望过去，才发现自己一说两只手，眼睛总先去右边，左肘却没有一同留出能回来的那点空处。

pairs.target: tā nuó hǎo dèng biān de wèizhì , xiān yòng zuǒshǒu kōng zhe zǒuyíbiàn , zài liǎng zhǎng yìtóng líkāi , yìtóng huílái , zhèhuí méiyǒu ràng yòushǒu zài bànlù děng zhe bǔ zuǒshǒu .
pairs.english: He adjusted his position beside the stool, first rehearsed with his left hand empty once, then lifted and returned both palms together; this time he did not leave the right waiting halfway to make up for the left.
pairs.hanzi: 他挪好凳边的位置，先用左手空着走一遍，再两掌一同离开、一同回来，这回没有让右手在半路等着补左手。

pairs.target: lín kē wèn jì bu jì , tǎ wéi bǎ bǐ dìgěi tā , tā bù jiē , ná xiàbā zhǐ tā de cèzi , shuō búshì yǐjīng shuō guò le me , tā zhǐhǎo zìjǐ xiào zhe xiě .
pairs.english: Lin Ke asked whether he would record it; Tavi offered her the pen; she refused it, pointing her chin at his notebook and asking whether she had not said so already; he had to write it himself with a smile.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂问记不记，塔维把笔递给她，她不接，拿下巴指他的册子，说不是已经说过了么，他只好自己笑着写。

pairs.target: tā yào zǒushí , sòng yuǎn méi jiào tā děng tiě lái le zài kàn , tǎ wéi sòngdào ménbiān , shuō xiàhuí ruò zài wèn tā , huì bǎ yào kàn shénme xiān jiǎngqīng , bù bái zhàn zhè yíkè .
pairs.english: When she had to leave, Song Yuan did not ask her to wait for the iron to arrive before watching; Tavi walked her to the door, saying next time, if he asked her again, he would first explain it: what she was to watch, without wasting this quarter-hour.
pairs.hanzi: 她要走时，宋远没叫她等铁来了再看，塔维送到门边，说下回若再问她，会把要看什么先讲清，不白占这一刻。

pairs.target: lín kē shuō yě bié jiǎng chéng zìjǐ yìlái tā jiù chéng le , fāngcái tā zhàn zài zhèlǐ , liǎngzhī yǎnjīng kàn de qīngqīngchǔchǔ , tā huíwū shí hái tīngjiàn tā zài láng xià xiào .
pairs.english: Lin Ke said he should not describe her arrival as making him succeed either; she had stood right here just now and seen everything clearly with both eyes; back in the room he could still hear her laughing in the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂说也别讲成自己一来他就成了，方才她站在这里，两只眼睛看得清清楚楚，他回屋时还听见她在廊下笑。

pairs.target: xiē guò yízhèn , wéi lǎoshī cái qǔ yuánlái nà duì tiě lái , xiān bù jiā qīngzài , chá guò luǒ miàn hé qiǎn cáo , fēnbié gē huí mù tuō , yòu kàn duǎnshéng hé jià yán .
pairs.english: Only after a rest did Teacher Vey fetch the original iron pair, first without light loads; she checked the bare patches and shallow grooves, set each back in its carrier, and checked the short cords and rack edges too.
pairs.hanzi: 歇过一阵，维老师才取原来那对铁来，先不加轻载，查过裸面和浅槽，分别搁回木托，又看短绳和架沿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn jīnrì shìbushì biàn néng liú yíxià , tā shuō jīnrì zhǐ chá huíshǒu , liǎng zhǎng kěyǐ tiēzhe rèn pǔtōng fǎnyìng , bù jiē biànhuà , yě bù tái zhe zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether today he could retain it briefly; she said today they checked only the hands' return: both palms could touch and identify ordinary responses, without linking a change or walking with them raised.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问今日是不是便能留一下，她说今日只查回手，两掌可以贴着认普通反应，不接变化，也不抬着走。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , méiyǒu jiāng lín kē kànjiàn de nà yìhuí shuō chéng yǐjīng gòu le , xiān rèn liǎngchù biānjiè hé jiēzhǎng de wèizhì , zài jiāng gāngcái nàtiáo shǒu lù mànmàn zǒuguò .
pairs.english: He nodded, not calling the attempt that Lin Ke had seen sufficient already; he first identified both boundaries and the palm-contact positions, then slowly traced the hand route from before.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，没有将林珂看见的那一回说成已经够了，先认两处边界和接掌的位置，再将刚才那条手路慢慢走过。

pairs.target: liǎng zhǎng líkāi shí , tiě méiyǒu shénme biànhuà , huílái yě méiyǒu , sòng yuǎn jiào tā bǎ zhèjiàn yě jì míng , miǎnde wǎnghòu zhǐ jìde nàtiān ná guò tiě .
pairs.english: When both palms lifted the iron showed no change of any kind, nor on returning; Song Yuan told him to record this too, lest later he remembered only holding iron that day.
pairs.hanzi: 两掌离开时，铁没有什么变化，回来也没有，宋远叫他把这件也记明，免得往后只记得那天拿过铁。

pairs.target: tā zuò wán yìhuí biàn zuòxià , shǒuzhǐ mōqīng bǐgǎn , yǎnlǐ yě bú lèi , wéi lǎoshī cái wèn xià yícì xiǎng zuò nǎ jiàn , tā shuō xiānzhào zhège wèizhì liú yìxiǎo xià , zài huílái shōu .
pairs.english: After one attempt he sat, his fingers feeling the pen clearly and his eyes not tired either; only then did Teacher Vey ask what he wanted to do next time; he said first retain it briefly in this position, then come back to cancel.
pairs.hanzi: 他做完一回便坐下，手指摸清笔杆，眼里也不累，维老师才问下一次想做哪件，他说先照这个位置留一小下，再回来收。

pairs.target: tā shuō xià yícì yào cóng qīngzài qǐdiǎn zài chá , zhǐ shì zhè yíjiàn , sòng yuǎn yě děi zài , bù ná jīnrì méi pènghuài dōngxī dàngchéng dào nǎlǐ dōu néng zuò .
pairs.english: She said next time they must recheck from the light-load baseline and try only this one task, with Song Yuan present too; today's undamaged objects did not mean he could do it anywhere.
pairs.hanzi: 她说下一次要从轻载起点再查，只试这一件，宋远也得在，不拿今日没碰坏东西当成到哪里都能做。

pairs.target: tiě réng shōuhuí guì lǐ , ǎi jià què liúzài bù diàn shàng , tǎ wéi ná kōng mù tuō zài bǎi le yícì , méi jìxù liàn , zhǐ bǎ liǎngzhī dōu fàngdào néng kànqīng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: The iron went back to the cupboard as before, but the low rack stayed on the padding; Tavi set the empty carriers out once more, without further practice, only placing both where they were clearly visible.
pairs.hanzi: 铁仍收回柜里，矮架却留在布垫上，塔维拿空木托再摆了一次，没继续练，只把两只都放到能看清的位置。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn cóng ménpáng ná qǐ lín kē wàngdài de hùjù , shuō yǒurén fāngcái zǒu de hěn shénqì , tǎ wéi wàng yìyǎn láng wài , wèn zhèhuí shì shuí tì shuí jìzhù le .
pairs.english: Song Yuan picked up Lin Ke's forgotten gear by the door, saying someone had left looking very grand; Tavi glanced into the corridor and asked who had remembered for whom this time.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远从门旁拿起林珂忘带的护具，说有人方才走得很神气，塔维望一眼廊外，问这回是谁替谁记住了。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zǒu dào xià yìjiān kèshì ménkǒu , méiyǒu hǎn tā chūlái , děng ménbiān de rén dì jìnqù , guò le yíhuìer , lín kē de duǎn biàn xiān cóng rényǐng lǐ jǐ le chūlái .
pairs.english: They walked to the next classroom door, without calling her out, waiting while someone by the door passed it inside; after a while Lin Ke's short braid emerged first between the figures.
pairs.hanzi: 两人走到下一间课室门口，没有喊她出来，等门边的人递进去，过了一会儿，林珂的短辫先从人影里挤了出来。

pairs.target: tā jiēguò hùjù , shuō zìjǐ huílái qǔ yě láidejí , tǎ wéi diǎntóu , méi shuō láibùjí , zhǐ jiāng kōng zhe de liǎngzhīshǒu tān gěi tā kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: She took the gear, saying she would have had time to return for it too; Tavi nodded without saying otherwise, only gave her a look at his two empty hands for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 她接过护具，说自己回来取也来得及，塔维点头，没说来不及，只将空着的两只手摊给她看了一眼。
